A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a framework to model multi-resolution weak supervision sources with arbitrary correlation structures and show that our framework can be applied to a variety of tasks and data modalities.
we introduce a novel weak supervision framework for sequential data, Dugong, which can be used to assign probabilistic annotations to training data.

Dugong is a general purpose weak supervision framework that models multi resolution weak supervision for sequential data, can be used for a variety of tasks like classification and segmentation and is applicable across domains like video and sensor data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Dugong is a general purpose approach to modeling multi resolution weak supervision for sequential data.
